dimensions.assessment: Establishes significant criminal penalties, including imprisonment up to 20 years for robbery, up to 25 years for armed assault, and up to life imprisonment if death results.
dimensions.evidence: if death results, shall be imprisoned for any term of years or life.

dimensions.assessment: Amends chapter 103 of title 18, United States Code, to establish new federal criminal offenses and jurisdiction over ATM-related violations regardless of physical premises.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 18, United States Code, to establish criminal offenses with respect to violations involving ATMs

dimensions.assessment: Creates permanent statutory criminal offenses under federal law with nationwide reach.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends federal criminal law regarding ATM-related crimes, establishing specific offenses, fines, and prison terms up to life imprisonment for crimes resulting in death, affecting financial institutions, ATM users, servicers, and offenders nationwide.
